The platform

One system, from a molecule imagined to a material delivered.

Traditional discovery is slow, linear, and human-paced. Ours is a continuous arc — design, build, process, deliver — where software, chemistry, and biology operate as a single instrument.

Discover
Step 01

Design

AI models generate candidate molecules, proteins, pathways, and process conditions aimed at a specific performance or cost target.

Automate
Step 02

Build & test

Robotic chemical and biological labs synthesize and screen candidates at high throughput, closing the loop between design and result.

Engineer
Step 03

Process & scale

Winners move through process development to pilot and commercial scale — chemical, biological, biocatalytic, or hybrid routes.

Deliver
Step 04

Deliver

Specialty materials, custom synthesis, toll processing, and licensable process technology for the world's most demanding industries.

The differentiator

A closed loop that gets smarter every cycle.

No single molecule is the moat. The flywheel is: every physical experiment sharpens the models, and better models multiply the return on every experiment that follows.

1

Design

AI generates candidate molecules, proteins, pathways, and conditions — searching a space far larger than any team could explore by hand.

2

Build

Automated chemistry and biology synthesize and express the candidates, turning digital designs into physical matter.

3

Test

High-throughput screening and analytics measure what was actually made — real, high-quality data grounded in the physical world.

4

Learn

Results retrain the models. The next design is sharper — and the loop runs again, faster and better-informed.

Three co-equal sciences

Depth in every discipline. Value in the connections.

Most companies pursue one of these in isolation. We treat chemistry, biology, and AI as first-class peers — and invest in each as heavily as the others.

Pillar 01
Chemistry

Chemistry

Synthesis · separation · scale-up

  • Process chemistry: synthesis, catalysis, separation science
  • Chemical engineering & continuous-flow scale-up
  • Analytical chemistry to trace, electronic-grade purity
  • Process safety, quality systems, TSCA / REACH
Pillar 02
Biology

Biology

Cells · enzymes · bioprocess

  • Synthetic biology & metabolic engineering
  • Bioprocess: fermentation, culture, downstream
  • Enzymology, biocatalysis & directed evolution
  • Protein engineering & analytical biology
Pillar 03
AI & Software

AI & Software

Models · automation · infrastructure

  • Generative & geometric deep learning for molecules
  • Active learning that picks the next experiment
  • Lab automation, control software & MLOps
  • Data platform, HPC & physics-informed models
Parallel fermentation — biology, running at process scale
Living systems, engineered

Where cells become chemistry.

Our bioprocess platform turns engineered organisms into production systems — parallel fermentation, real-time gas and metabolite monitoring, and downstream recovery tuned to each molecule.

The same closed loop applies: strains and conditions are designed by models, run across parallel reactors, and every batch feeds data back to sharpen the next design.

The people who define us

We hire across the boundaries others hire within.

The scarcest, most valuable talent isn't a specialist in any single field — it's the translators fluent enough to reason from a protein, to the model predicting it, to the infrastructure running that model.

Leadership pairs deep scientific founders with an experienced operator — because coordinating chemists, biologists, and software engineers takes organizational skill equal to the technical breadth.

Leadership

ML scientists with wet-lab grounding

The people who understand why molecular data breaks the usual assumptions — and build models that stay honest to the underlying physics and chemistry. They've stood at the bench, so they know what a prediction has to survive in the real world.

Engineering

Research software engineers

They take ideas that work once in a notebook and turn them into systems that run every day at scale. Careful, pragmatic, and unglamorous in the best way — they are the reason the platform is dependable rather than a demo.

Science

Bench-to-scale scientists

Chemists and biologists who carry a discovery all the way from a first result to something a plant can make, ton after ton, without losing the science along the way. They are fluent in both the possible and the practical.

Integration

Full-stack translators

The rare few who can reason from a protein, to the model predicting its behavior, to the infrastructure running that model — and speak clearly to each. They are the connective tissue that keeps three very different disciplines moving as one.
